name: obsidian-second-brain
tagline_zh: 你的 Obsidian 笔记库会自己长脑子：旧笔记被新信息自动改写，矛盾自动和解，夜里 AI 替你维护。醒来发现。
tagline_en: Your Obsidian vault grows a mind: old notes rewrite themselves, contradictions reconcile, and while you sleep.
desc_en: Operate any Obsidian vault as a living, self-rewriting second brain (an evolution of Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern: sources rewrite existing pages, contradictions reconcile automatically, scheduled agents maintain the vault while you sleep). Use this skill whenever the user asks Claude to read, write, update, search, or manage their Obsidian vault - including saving notes from conversation, creating
why_zh: 不同于普通笔记工具，它让笔记互相改写、矛盾自动消解，像活的第二大脑，而非静态仓库。
why_en: Unlike static note tools, it lets notes rewrite each other and auto-resolve conflicts—a living second brain, not a filing cabinet.
